source_items.title: Retain complete immutable Worker death proof for Node-loss cleanup

base.action: Retain the accepted complete WorkerDeathRecord after installing its owner fence, and use it in Node-loss cleanup instead of the narrow reference-table record.

enhanced.action: Retain; verify conflicting replay cannot rebind stored history.

hunks.extract: Keep full death record keyed by WorkerID after exact installed-fence consumption; reject conflicting replay.
Use the immutable WorkerDeathRecord, not ObjectOwnerTable.dead_worker_record().

source_items.why: Base dead_worker_record returns DeadWorkerReferenceRecord, while NodeLostOutputResolution only accepts ReleaseContainedReferenceReply or WorkerDeathRecord. A confirmed dead child currently supplies the wrong type and leaves Node-loss cleanup unresolved.
source_items.replacement: Keep the existing local owner death fence as the authority and retain its exact full membership death proof alongside it. No enhanced publication authority, graph or client is added to B. Enhanced put/GC reuse of the full proof is accounted as receipt support rather than a separately proven B fix.
validation: With a registered one-output manifest containing a child, install exact PROCESS_EXIT/NODE_EXIT child death then run Node-loss cleanup. No Release RPC is made to the dead child; resolution receives WorkerDeathRecord and drains.

source_items.title: Complete old-output retirement with exact installed child death

base.action: Accept exact installed Worker death per final hold after shared proof validation; migrate pure owner retirement coverage.

enhanced.action: Retain the common death-settlement fix, keep enhanced graph calls outside the shared owner authority.

hunks.extract: Import WorkerDeathReason and WorkerDeathRecord.
Retirement receipt accepts real release or WorkerDeathRecord.
Matching API union and exact-proof documentation.
Check full immutable death identity against the installed owner-table fence before applying any receipt.
Validate death Worker and confirmed exit reason in each final-hold position.
Compare complete installed death identity without importing Core.

For each retirement child release, consume CF-001 exact installed death in current[child]; only living owners need real Release RPC. The extra enhanced deaths dictionary and publication fence/retire calls are not required in B.

source_items.why: Base retirement always calls a dead child owner for Release and its receipt type cannot represent confirmed death. The old output cannot retire, blocking reconstruction and leaving shutdown obligations active.

evidence.note: Unconditional child Release RPC with no death settlement.
Entire pure test uses common owner/protocol types and no enhanced publication import.

source_items.replacement: Port exact per-hold Worker-death settlement and immutable fence checks to both owner tables, using CF-001 in the base Core retirement driver. Keep true Release and Drop receipts; no fabricated ACK, no graph requirement, and no base GCS publication callback.
validation: Run equivalent pure owner cases in both versions: mixed real Release plus death; one death covering two distinct final holds; exact replay; mutated nested death input.

Reject missing/uninstalled proof, wrong installed identity, other Worker, EXPECTED exit, changed incarnation, missing hold and changed replay atomically; preserve LOST state/lineage/live tokens and pending retirement on every rejection.
Base Core-level test installs a child death, retires old LOST result without calling dead owner, then admits next attempt only after all child/replica effects settle.

source_items.title: Latch Node-loss completion decision across cleanup retries

base.action: Read existing cleanup work first; preserve its complete value including None; do not record new Complete on ABORTED.

enhanced.action: Retain the same retry latch. Central complete discovery remains enhanced only.

hunks.extract: Reuse latched[complete] when work exists, including None, and retain ABORTED guard before record_complete. Exclude central.complete from the B expression.

source_items.why: First Node-loss pass can latch UNKNOWN/DROP and abort, then fail child cleanup. A late envelope is still available via obligation.envelope fallback on retry; Base recomputes Complete and record_complete rejects the ABORTED handoff, so cleanup cannot resume.

evidence.note: Envelope fallback, recomputation, stored cleanup choice and abort.
ABORTED cannot accept a new Complete.

source_items.replacement: Preserve one local Node-loss decision for the existing cleanup transaction, including an explicit absent Complete. No central query, central terminal knowledge or GCS receipt is added to B.
validation: One output with child reference: lose publisher before owner Complete; fail first child Release; deliver a late valid result envelope; retry. Original UNKNOWN/DROP decision remains fixed, both holds close, no adoption occurs, and unresolved cleanup drains.
Repeat late envelope after completion: no new cleanup, no known-success reclassification and no new adoption. Retain known-complete/surviving-bytes behavior as a separate positive control.
source_items.symbol: Latch Node-loss completion decision across cleanup retries

source_items.title: Rotate existing owner-fence effects after blocked attempts

base.action: Round-robin existing pending owner-fence effects on every attempt.

enhanced.action: Retain pending-effect rotation; retain publication/sweep alternation only in enhanced.

hunks.extract: Add only _owner_fence_progress_cursor initialization.
Select pending[cursor % len(pending)] under existing owner-fence lock, increment on attempts, then invoke RPC outside the lock. Exclude publication pending/choice/use_publication/drive_one logic.

source_items.why: Base always attempts stable pending[0]. A PINNED, timeout or conflicting reply intentionally remains pending and can prevent independent later owner/Node fences from ever being attempted.

evidence.note: Pending effects use stable order and skip only completed entries.
Timeout and incomplete/PINNED replies leave first effect pending.
Existing test covers class alternation only, not fairness among base fence effects.

source_items.replacement: Fairly schedule the already existing B membership/owner-fence outbox. B already contains GCSLite for membership; this does not introduce central publication or graph semantics.
validation: Create two actual registry pending fence effects. First remains PINNED or times out, second returns its exact accepted complete ACK. Within bounded attempts second completes while first stays pending.
Wrong/mismatched or duplicate ACK must not discharge the blocked effect. After list shrink, rotation remains in bounds. Assert RPC executes outside the selection lock.

Keep public path; add bounded --case EXACT for registered gate/migration selections. No arbitrary pytest passthrough, glob, directory or --all.

single_manifest.enhanced_change: Use the same schema with edition=enhanced; maintain its own gate and migration registrations; never inherit graph expectations into base.
single_manifest.scope_expansion: No automatic import of old108/455. Explicit reviewed migration registration is allowed; common correctness regressions enter B/E gates with an auditable delta. Gate and executable set are distinct.
validation: strict finite JSON schema and duplicate-key rejection
nonempty unique pure files; exact in-root .py files
exact nonempty smoke selectors+known marker enum; no glob/path traversal/directory/package
no duplicate or conflicting marker for same selector
known_non_unit exact selectors must belong to a listed pure file, remain -m unit excluded, and never silently become smoke gate
list/validation imports no test modules and starts no pytest
no CLI arbitrary timeout/pytest-args/backend override
reject registry duplicates and conflicting gate/registry marker; promotion moves rather than duplicates entry
unit whole-file execution only for reviewed unit files; mixed/process cases require exact selector
--case uses unchanged isolated process-tree/environment kernel and 30-second limit
reviewed migration file/config/transitive-helper hash drift rejects execution until re-review; no test imports during validation
list distinguishes delivery_gate versus reviewed_migration and never executes either
single_manifest.budget_policy: keep implementation constants30s test deadline,2s cleanup grace,0.25s process snapshot,timeout exit124; schema does not expose knobs
single_manifest.schema_migration: Schema2 keeps existing path and pure gate list, adds explicit smoke marker, known_nonunit, and reviewed_migrations. Only one current schema; old tags retain their original runner.

reviewed_migration_record_schema.selector: exact tests/...py file (unit only) or tests/...py::function[param] case
reviewed_migration_record_schema.review_source_commit: actual checked-out full SHA; with reviewed_tree_hash identifies uncommitted reviewed files too
reviewed_migration_record_schema.reviewed_tree_hash: hash of sorted per-file transitive import-closure hashes
reviewed_migration_record_schema.reviewed_files: mapping of repository-relative Python/config inputs to SHA256, including discovered helper closure
reviewed_migration_record_schema.cost_review: finite processes/threads/endpoints/payload and production timeout/cleanup path review; does not change fixed runner limit

sets.delivery_gate: pure and smoke; initially mapped from historical per-edition baseline, plus required common regressions promoted with recorded rationale
sets.reviewed_migrations: additional individually reviewed file/case entries, never executed by default CI/full gate
sets.executable_set: union of gate entries and reviewed_migrations; no unregistered caller-supplied paths
sets.promotion: record reason/cost/old-new selector map; move migration entry into gate atomically, keep its prior result as history
sets.retirement: retire old executable CLI only after new --case supports required migrations and cleanup proofs pass

safety_invariants: require POSIX before Popen; unsupported Windows listing only
one serial child per smoke; pure fixedbatch
positive PID/PGID checks; never signal runner PID/PGID
fresh proc/ps snapshots and identity-aware descendant tracking, detached grandchildren, PID-reuse checks
TERM bounded grace then KILL then exact child reap
timeout or KeyboardInterrupt/error kills owned tree and does not become success
no outer CI timeout terminating cleanup owner before it finishes; retain overall job guard
execution.case_mode: Run exactly one registered gate or migration unit file/case using its explicit marker and same POSIX cleanup kernel; reject arbitrary selectors/options.
execution.migration_gate_boundary: --pure/CI full gate excludes registry-only migrations; case result binds exact source+closure hashes and work package.

ci.each_job: Checkout resolved edition candidate, record event/branch/SHA identities, install own lock and run own delivery gate. Explicit migration dispatch results stay separate; no automatic full registry execution.
ci.environment: pin recorded Python3.12 patch and uv0.11.26; choose explicit supported Ubuntu runner image, record resolved kernel and package/build versions; CI still needs actual run evidence
ci.serial: one pure batch then exact smokes serial within each job; no pytest-xdist or merged list

structural_packages.title: P7：从清理基础版适配两项增强，不恢复旧协议族
structural_packages.design_and_invariants:
增强原快照含三个新增生产模块 enhanced_publication.py、enhanced_publication_client.py、enhanced_publication_control.py；两协议净增量约1,722代码行，整体基础复杂度远大于该增量。P7保持其 **一个GCS记录authority**，不另造graph truth。按P1-P6新的结果与责任边界移植所需wire/handler/adapter，不 cherry-pick旧Core/Node全文件。

**具体接线**：

1. Node已经实际owner注册后，GCS C0 INTENT/C1图PREPARED；前进失败保留准确清单/unknown。P2实际journal preparation出具TaskPrepared receipt再ARM C2。
2. C3仍为Node local Complete+resource release；P2 progress向GCS报告准确C4及owner，C4 ACK未知不重执行。
3. OwnerObjects在owner CAS前调用窄PublicationClient.ensure_committed()完成C5；P3本地C6后提交C7，收到精确C7才能正常退休Node回复托管。历史重放与当前权限仍分开。
4. Put使用真实operation manifest，绝不伪造Task lease/Complete；P4 put work保留成功membership直到GC。重建先完成旧retirement再新graph admission，不加cross-epoch原子替换协议。
5. P4收集真实child Release/death回执，owner先fence，有效边未解除图不退。preBegin firstFence只建立精确负许可，不能声称建立execution epoch；活跃后继旁也允许旧否决请求准确收口。
6. GCS ownerdeath与owner-wide Node sweep继续独立；Node死仅解除其私有bytes/source，存活child hold须真实Release。既有progress线程公平推进，不添cleaner service。pre-Core drain只等待dead-owner增强清理；所有live graphs只能在Core GC之后的最终GCS drain验证。

**状态表必须保留**：

| 窗口 | 改表后的准确事实 | 继续/补偿与验收 |
|---|---|---|
| W1 PREPARED后child失败 | GCS graph保守占用；journal每child实际sent/ACK；owner未adopt | owner/Node/GCS前进fence→所有可能hold exactRelease→graph retire；late promote不复活 |
| W2 C3成功/C4 ACK未知 | Node Complete与lease convergence独立；GCS可能已有C4；bytes独立 | query/精确重放，不双清账不重复执行；无C4仅ARM不能升级known success；无bytes为LOST |
| W3 C5后C6前/后 | GCS graph commit不等于owner READY；owner exact adoption可历史查询 | pending只能尝试当前CAS；READY/未知C7不得回滚；actual C7 ACK后退休response；earlyclose不能越过尾部屏障 |
| W4 READY→LOST/新attempt/GC | 旧membership、attemptfence、commit/release/adoption历史分别保留 | 旧责任收口后新epoch；旧commit不插回图，旧release不删新hold；对象GC不抹紧凑历史 |

**最终证据**：增强自己的共同基础回归＋新增C0–C7/graph保证＋W1–W4组合；现有通过公共支持操作到达的二对象重建cycle和真实并发PREPARED-reservation四对象cycle必须在新实现复验。基础版不提供全局拒环保证，不能为对照给它加空图endpoint或用图测试反向阻塞交付。语义对照保留 UNKNOWN vs knownComplete/LOST、C7依赖、graph CYCLE等差异，不仅比较归一化trace。

common_fixes.title: Retain complete immutable Worker death proof for Node-loss cleanup

base.action: Retain the accepted complete WorkerDeathRecord after installing its owner fence, and use it in Node-loss cleanup instead of the narrow reference-table record.

enhanced.action: Retain; verify conflicting replay cannot rebind stored history.

hunks.extract: Keep full death record keyed by WorkerID after exact installed-fence consumption; reject conflicting replay.
Use the immutable WorkerDeathRecord, not ObjectOwnerTable.dead_worker_record().

common_fixes.why: Base dead_worker_record returns DeadWorkerReferenceRecord, while NodeLostOutputResolution only accepts ReleaseContainedReferenceReply or WorkerDeathRecord. A confirmed dead child currently supplies the wrong type and leaves Node-loss cleanup unresolved.
common_fixes.replacement: Keep the existing local owner death fence as the authority and retain its exact full membership death proof alongside it. No enhanced publication authority, graph or client is added to B. Enhanced put/GC reuse of the full proof is accounted as receipt support rather than a separately proven B fix.
